title: EMA Multi-TF Crossover Grid with Modify-TP breakeven target
entry_long: On H1: EMA8 crosses above EMA18 AND EMA8>EMA100 (uptrend align) sets buy-mode=1; on M1 grid opens buy every 100 pips while buy-mode=1
entry_short: mirror: EMA8 crosses below EMA18 AND EMA8<EMA100 sets sell-mode=1; grid sells every 100 pips while sell-mode=1
exit: modify TP to breakeven (average price) +/-50 pips per basket; no SL; cut-loss at -30% of balance closes all + resets
buildon_idea: add explicit lot cap (e.g. 1.0 lot) since none stated; try widening grid step per set (100/200/400/800) as narrator suggests to reduce basket size
novelty_note: multi-timeframe trend filter (H1) gating a M1 grid martingale-lite; common fxDreema pattern

title: EMA3/8/200 Multi-TF Crossover Grid with capped lot and Modify-TP
entry_long: H1: EMA3 crosses above EMA8 AND EMA3>EMA200 sets buy-mode=1; M1 grid opens buy every 100 pips while buy-mode=1
entry_short: mirror: EMA3 crosses below EMA8 AND EMA3<EMA200 sets sell-mode=1
exit: modify TP to breakeven average price +50 pips (buy) / -50 pips (sell); no SL; cut-loss money -3000 (30% of 10000) closes+terminates EA
buildon_idea: already capped 1.0 lot; flat-lot test first; try pending limit orders instead of grid market opens to reduce spread cost
novelty_note: same mechanism as first 185 upload with explicit lot cap and terminate-on-cutloss added

title: Demand/Supply Zone reversal entry with reverse-trend martingale recovery
entry_long: detect 3-4 consecutive down candles spanning >200 pips (downtrend), arm buy signal; when price closes back above EMA8 within 15 candles, open first buy
entry_short: mirror: 3-4 consecutive up candles >200 pips, arm sell signal; price closes back below EMA8 within 15 candles opens first sell
exit: trend-mode closes at +30 USD profit; reverse/recovery-mode (adverse move) closes at only +5 USD; cut-loss -3000 USD closes all
buildon_idea: already capped at 1.0 lot; flat-lot test first; the demand/supply zone entry itself (candle-run + EMA reclaim) is reusable outside the martingale wrapper
novelty_note: candle-run distance + EMA-reclaim as a reversal-zone detector is a distinct idea from plain EMA cross; grid/martingale wrapper is standard

title: EMA8/18/100 crossover entry with win/loss-driven money management ladder (Setup Money Management)
entry_long: EMA8 crosses above EMA18 at candle ID3 (holds through present), EMA8 above EMA100, and gap between EMA8/EMA18 > 5 pips (input-configurable)
entry_short: mirror: EMA8 crosses below EMA18 at candle ID3, EMA8 below EMA100, gap > 5 pips
exit: fixed SL 300 pips / TP 500 pips per trade; time filter 14:00-21:00 server; lot increases +0.01 on a losing close, decreases -0.01 on a winning close (money-management ladder), resets when balance exceeds balance_bs
buildon_idea: add an explicit max-lot cap since none is stated; flat-lot test first to isolate whether the EMA entry itself has edge apart from the ladder
novelty_note: win/loss-adaptive lot ladder (increase on loss, decrease on win, reset on balance recovery) layered on a plain EMA cross entry with real SL/TP - distinct from the usual grid/martingale-by-distance pattern

title: EMA3/8/200 trend entry with capped Recovery-Factor lot-ladder and SL/TP

exit: fixed SL 500 pips / TP 1000 pips per trade; recovery ladder increases lot on a losing close, decreases on a winning close, resets when balance exceeds balance_bs

novelty_note: named 'Recovery Factor Strategy' by narrator - win/loss-adaptive lot ladder with hard SL/TP and volume cap, same family as EX188/XbXw8jN2FJg but with real stops and an explicit cap

title: Multigroup Scalping EA - RSI dual-TF oversold/overbought + doji reversal, two independent grid groups
timeframe: H1 (RSI filter) / M1 (current TF, RSI period 7)
entry_long: Group1: RSI H1 <30 (oversold) AND RSI M1(7) <30, plus prior candle is a doji with lower wick > half of it longer than upper wick -> open first buy
entry_short: Group2: RSI H1 >70 (overbought) AND RSI M1(7) >70, plus prior candle is a doji with upper wick longer -> open first sell
exit: close whole basket (both groups combined) at +30 USD profit; cut-loss -3000 USD closes all
buildon_idea: already capped at 0.2 lot; flat-lot test first; the two independent buy/sell groups act as a natural hedge - test each group in isolation to see if either has standalone edge
novelty_note: two independently-triggered grid groups (RSI-oversold-buy group and RSI-overbought-sell group) that net against each other in trend moves - distinct structure from single-group grid EAs

title: Multigroup Scalping EA with Hedging Rebalance - RSI dual-TF + doji, two groups each carrying an opposite hedge leg
timeframe: H1 (RSI filter) / M1 (current TF, RSI period 7)
entry_long: Group1: RSI H1 <30 AND RSI M1(7) <30 plus doji with long lower wick -> open first buy (group1); group1 also opens a fixed 0.01 sell hedge leg on adverse moves
entry_short: Group2: RSI H1 >70 AND RSI M1(7) >70 plus doji with long upper wick -> open first sell (group2); group2 also opens a fixed 0.01 buy hedge leg on adverse moves
exit: close both groups together when combined profit > 5 USD; cut-loss -3000 USD closes all
buildon_idea: already capped at 0.1 lot; flat-lot test first; narrator notes it struggles to close in sideways markets (only closes once a real trend emerges) - worth testing a time-based force-close as an extra exit
novelty_note: explicit two-way hedge structure where each group's losing side is offset by a fixed-lot opposite-direction leg, intended to survive long drawdown drags better than a single-direction grid

title: Multigroup Scalping EA - RSI Divergence (5/10 candle reference) plus EMA100 trend filter, two groups
timeframe: M1/M5 (RSI period 7 tuned for small TF)
entry_long: Group1: prior candle close above EMA100; bullish RSI divergence (candle ID1 low < ID5 low < ID10 low i.e. new lows, while RSI ID5 > RSI ID10); prior candle bullish with higher volume than ID2; RSI < 30 (oversold) -> open first buy
entry_short: Group2: mirror - prior close below EMA100; bearish divergence (higher highs while RSI makes lower highs); prior candle bearish with higher volume; RSI > 70 -> open first sell
exit: close combined groups at +10 USD; cut-loss -3000 USD (implied, same family default)
buildon_idea: already capped at 0.1 lot; flat-lot test first; narrator's own backtest shows RSI level tuning (70/30 vs 65/35) swings order count 587->2592 and drawdown 31%->23% - sweep this lever explicitly before verdict
novelty_note: simplified RSI-divergence detector using only two reference candles (ID5, ID10) instead of full swing-point scanning - narrator explicitly contrasts this cheaper method with EX181's more rigorous divergence search

title: Multigroup Scalping EA - rigorous RSI Divergence (5/10 ref + volume + candle-color) with ATR trailing-stop trend mode and capped martingale recovery mode
entry_long: Group1: prior close above EMA100; bullish divergence via ID1/ID5/ID10 lows+RSI as in _GGfXVctDUM; prior candle bullish with higher volume than ID2; RSI<30 -> open first buy 0.01
entry_short: Group2: mirror bearish divergence with EMA100 filter, bearish candle+volume confirm, RSI>70 -> open first sell 0.01
exit: trend-mode (price extending favorably) uses ATR-scaled trailing stop (avg-true-range x2, trailing-step 10 to reduce order spam); reverse/recovery-mode (price against position) grids every 100 pips with lot-ladder +0.01 per 5 orders, capped at max 50 orders and closes basket at a lot-count-scaled profit target (5 + orders/5 x 5 USD)
escalation_cap: 50 orders max (capped), 0.1 lot volume upper limit per order
buildon_idea: already capped at 50 orders / 0.1 lot per order with dynamic ATR trailing exit on the trend leg; flat-lot test the recovery leg in isolation since it is the more expensive-to-verify half of this EA
novelty_note: most sophisticated variant in this batch - combines RSI divergence entry, volume/candle-color confirmation, ATR-adaptive trailing stop on the winning leg, and a hard-capped order-count recovery grid on the losing leg; narrator explicitly says this trades far less often (higher accuracy) than the simpler EX190 sibling
